decks.notes: The deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, combining with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage and power up Grinding Station for a combo win condition. It also includes control elements like Spell Snare and Malevolent Rumble to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently, using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Mox Amber for acceleration while Boseiju, Who Endures provides protection for key spells.

The main focus of this Mardu Aggro deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy using a combination of creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, along with spells like Thoughtseize and Galvanic Discharge to quickly deplete the opponent's resources and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Jegantha, the Wellspring and Arena of Glory offer additional benefits and support for the aggressive playstyle. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and maintain control of the battlefield throughout the match.

The deck focuses on disruption and control through a mix of counter spells, removal, and hand disruption. It aims to efficiently deal with threats on the board while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes cards like Fatal Push and Counterspell to handle threats, along with Unearth and Thought Scour for card advantage. The inclusion of creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provide a clock for the opponent while also being resilient threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and disruption.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells and removal, while also utilizing powerful enchantments like The One Ring to dominate the battlefield. It also includes versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler for added control and Snapcaster Mage for card advantage. The deck's mana base is optimized for flexibility and consistency, allowing for smooth gameplay and access to a variety of colors. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and establish a dominant position on the board to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using a combination of control elements, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own win conditions. Counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation are used to stop key spells, while removal spells like Fatal Push deal with threats. The deck also utilizes card draw cards like Preordain and Thought Scour to ensure a steady stream of resources. The win conditions include creature threats like Orcish Bowmasters and Abhorrent Oculus, as well as unique cards like Psychic Frog and Shoot the Sheriff. Overall, the emphasis is on control through disruption and advantage accumulation.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of removal spells, artifact ramp, and creature buffs, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing the synergy between Eldrazi creatures and support cards, the deck aims to close out games quickly through efficient aggression and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that can manipulate the graveyard, such as Living End, to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures. It includes various ways to cycle through the deck quickly and control the opponent's plays, while also having some protection against opposing spells. The deck aims to set up a board state where the opponent is unable to deal with the sudden influx of creatures and is forced to concede.

This deck aims to storm through the opponent using a combination of ritual effects, card draw, and burn spells to generate a large amount of mana and cast a lethal spell to win the game. The key strategy is to chain spells together, utilizing cards like Desperate Ritual, Pyretic Ritual, and Ral, Monsoon Mage to fuel explosive turns and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to react. Additionally, utilizing Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard and Wish to access specific combo pieces are crucial components of the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with rituals and ramp spells to cast multiple spells in a single turn, eventually leading to a powerful combo using Ral, Monsoon Mage to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and recursion spells like Past in Flames to maintain resources and ensure consistency in executing the combo. Additionally, some wish cards are included to provide flexibility and access to specific cards from the sideboard to further enhance the combo potential.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through cards and control the board until you are able to cast Living End, which will then bring back all the creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm your opponent. The deck includes cards that allow you to cycle through your deck quickly, counter spells from your opponent, and manipulate the board state to your advantage. The goal is to set up a powerful combo with Living End while disrupting your opponent's game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on high-powered aggressive creatures like Galvanic Discharge and Amped Raptor to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It also utilizes powerful support cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to control the board and push through for victory. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and powerful late-game potential. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures, removal, and support cards to secure the win in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on assembling the combination of Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Mishra's Bauble to create a loop that allows the player to mill their entire library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help generate mana and recur key pieces from the graveyard, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Malevolent Rumble provide card advantage and disruption. The land base includes ways to produce all necessary colors of mana and Boseiju, Who Endures can protect key spells from countermagic.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence to overwhelm opponents quickly. It includes a mix of powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls, along with disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Chained to the Rocks to control the game. The deck also features a variety of efficient removal spells and potent enchantments like The One Ring to further enhance its aggression. By combining speed, aggression, and disruption, this deck aims to close out games swiftly before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using Chord of Calling. The key strategy revolves around using Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to sacrifice creatures and draw cards, ultimately setting up combos with cards like Blood Artist and Malevolent Rumble to drain the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes Grist, the Hunger Tide to create tokens and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the board and win through attrition and incremental advantage.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize while also efficiently removing threats with Lightning Bolt and Tarfire. It aims to quickly build up a board presence with powerful creatures like Nethergoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also utilizing Mishra's Bauble and Street Wraith to cycle through the deck. Malevolent Rumble and Fear of Missing Out provide additional sources of damage, with Detective's Phoenix and Omnivorous Flytrap offering strong late-game threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with Arena of Glory to help close out games.

This deck focuses on aggressive early plays with efficient creatures and burn spells to pressure the opponent's life total quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana fixing and a backup plan for when the game goes long. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan and the Leyline cards provide additional protection and synergy with the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to win before the opponent can stabilize and mount a defense.
